 Women's Champions League - Game Week 5 Nov 18, 2026 - 12:45 Ciudad Real Madrid Disney+ will show Real Madrid Femenino v Inter live. Here's how to stream the match.
 Real Madrid Femenino face Inter at Ciudad Real Madrid with crucial Women's Champions League points at stake in the race to qualify.
 Pau Quesada's Real Madrid have had mixed results in recent weeks. They beat Paris FC 3-0 in the Champions League but drew 3-3 with FC Badalona in Liga F in their most recent league fixture.
 David Sassarini's Inter have had a tougher time. They lost 4-1 to Manchester City Women in their most recent European fixture, then fell 3-2 to Juventus in Serie A last weekend.
 Real Madrid sit seventh in the Women's Champions League standings, while Inter are 13th. The Milan side need points to climb the table.
